name: ZCA_BATCH_DETAILS
description: The ZCA_BATCH_DETAILS is a transactional table that holds details about each batch that is submitted via a job.

columns.name: BATCH_DETAIL_ID
columns.description: Sequence generated primary key.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION
columns.description: ESS job definition.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: PARENT_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the parent request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: BATCH_TYPE
columns.description: Type of the Batch

columns.name: SOURCE_DATA_LOCATION
columns.description: Location of source data to be processed by the batch

columns.name: SOURCE_TYPE
columns.description: The type of source data provided in field SOURCE_DATA_LOCATION

columns.name: BATCH_MODE
columns.description: Mode of batch. For example 'FULL','INCREMENTAL', 'RECOVER', etc.

columns.name: SOURCE_OBJECT_CODE
columns.description: The source object to import. Example - IB Asset, OSS Asset.

columns.name: NUMBER_OF_BATCHES
columns.description: Number of batches per source object code.

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: Batch Identifier.

columns.name: BATCH_STATUS
columns.description: Execution status of the batch. Valid values are 'QUEUED', 'PROCESSING', 'COMPLETE','ERROR'.

columns.name: PROCESSED_ROW_COUNT
columns.description: Number of rows processed with the batch.

columns.name: ERROR_MESSAGE
columns.description: Error message for the batch.

columns.name: RECOVERABLE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicator to show if the batch is 'RECOVERABLE or 'NON-RECOVERABLE'.

columns.name: RETRIES_LEFT
columns.description: Number of re-tries left for the batch.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: SOURCE_DATA
columns.description: Source data to be processed by the batch.
